name: 5128-solodecode-llama4scout-tp8
model: unsloth/Llama-4-Scout-17B-16E-Instruct -- an ungated mirror carrying the identical config.json and the same bf16 weights as `meta-llama/Llama-4-Scout-17B-16E-Instruct`; the Llama 4 Community License applies.
parallelism: TP=8, EP=1, PP=1. One node, no router, no external cache tier.
architecture: Llama4ForConditionalGeneration, bf16, 109B total parameters / 17B active; 217.3 GB of safetensors over 50 shards, so ~27 GB per card at TP8.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=1, warmup the first 20%, bounded at 50 requests with a 2400 s safety cap, so 40 requests are measured.
workload: guidellm `synthetic_text`, single turn, no prefix buckets: 1000 prompt tokens in and 1000 output tokens out, both fixed, with `ignore_eos: true` and `temperature: 0.0` so every request decodes the same number of steps.
purpose: A single-user long-form drafting assistant on a mixture-of-experts model, one request at a time across eight GPUs.
launch:
# Four arguments. Every other engine setting is a stock default of the pinned commit and is
# deliberately not written here.

model-path: unsloth/Llama-4-Scout-17B-16E-Instruct
tp-size: 8

# This is a multimodal architecture, so the engine multiplies mem-fraction-static by 0.90 on its
# own at startup: the effective figure is 0.72.
mem-fraction-static: 0.8

# The checkpoint advertises 10485760 positions. Left at that, the request tables sized from it do
# not fit; 8192 is the cap and this workload needs 2000.
context-length: 8192

disable-radix-cache: true
